info.title: DVD Rental API
info.description: A DVD rental service built with Effect-ts, PostgreSQL, and JWT authentication

get.description: Get a paginated list of films. Supports filtering by category, rating, and search term.
Get detailed information about a specific film including language and category.
Get the list of actors appearing in a specific film.
Get a list of all film categories.
Get a list of all rental stores with address information.
Get detailed information about a specific store.
Check availability of a film across all stores.
Check availability of a specific film at a specific store.

post.description: Rent a film to a customer. Checks inventory availability and customer status. Requires staff authentication.

put.description: Mark a rental as returned. Calculates late fees if applicable. Requires staff authentication.

get.description: Get detailed information about a specific rental. Requires authentication.
Get rental history for a specific customer. Requires authentication.
Get customer information by ID. Requires authentication.

post.description: Record a payment for a rental.

get.description: Get detailed information about a specific payment.
Get payment history for a specific customer.
Get outstanding balance for a customer.

post.description: Authenticate a customer and receive a JWT token.
Authenticate a staff member and receive a JWT token.

get.description: Get list of all staff members.
